lots.what_it_is: Mixed box of unmarked decorative ware, 7 pieces: (1) South-East Asian style long-stem smoking ('opium') pipe, about 40 cm, elephant-head bowl with trunk, tusks, ear rings, bell on a chain, filigree cage knop and wire bands, yellowish white metal or brass alloy, no mark visible; (2) pair of pale celadon crackle-glaze twin-handled vases (modern decorator); (3) single one-light gilt metal tole-style candle branch with two painted ceramic or resin parrots and flowers on a black and gilt base; (4) pair of Murano-style glass lovebirds on a clear base; (5) large ribbed oval clear glass bowl with frosted leaf handles holding about 12 faceted crystal balls; (6) heavy octagonal clear crystal dish or ashtray; (7) small green majolica-style leaf dish.
lots.score_reason: Decorative box whose value rests on the pipe and the parrot candle branch. The pipe form (wirework knop, animal bowl) sells about A$45 to 110 at European online rooms as white metal; the parrot branch is a single one-light piece of a design that sells in pairs for A$290 to 380 in the UK, so a single is likely well under half that. The rest is A$10 to 50 Gowans-level decorator glass and celadon. A realistic combined auction value is roughly A$100 to 200, more only if the pipe proves to be silver.
lots.condition: Pipe: tarnished, appears complete with bell and chain, no visible dents at photo resolution (450 x 600). Candle branch: gilding bright, flowers and parrots appear intact. Glass and celadon: no chips visible, but photos are small and no close-ups of rims or bases.
lots.key_photo_findings: Re-checked all 4 photos and enlarged the pipe bowl: elephant head clearly modelled (trunk curled up with chain and conical bell, short tusks, ring earrings), filigree cage knop and twisted wire bands on the stem. Colour is brassy grey, consistent with white metal or brass rather than bright silver; no hallmark or stamp visible anywhere, but the photo is low resolution and the underside is not shown. Candle branch is a single, not a pair, one candle cup only. No marks on any glass or ceramic piece shown.
